title: [PC, Ubisoft] Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands (Standard Edition) $4 @ Ubisoft
body:

[watdahelly] Really enjoyed this game, would recommend! The second game Breakpoint just didn't hit the same.
It's also $ 3.74 on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/460930/Tom_Clancys_Ghost_…
[Twisty] Breakpoint is also online only needing a connection all the time to play unfortunately
[p3r514n] My exact experience. Loved this, hated Breakpoint.
[burns13] Played Breakpoint recently after years of holding off. Happy to say the game is a very solid single player experience.
Devs did have a lot of post launch work to bring it back it in the right state. (Away from live service slop). I think they've done well.
[watdahelly] That's good to hear, I was thinking of revisiting it. I just started played Skull and Bones which is by Ubisoft and it's actually pretty fun after all the fixes.
[Pennywisepound12] Can you please share you thoughts on how the gun play feels like? Im a great fan of (this will be shocking) rockstar's third person gunplay, especially Max Payne 3. Is it somewhat similar?
Ordinarily, I stay away from ubislop games due to sp microtransactions but I could make an exception for $5.
[JustWantToSave] Wildlands currently has twitch drops till august 21st 1:59am
So random.
[GunnerMcDagget] The reason for the sale is that it's Ghost Recon's 25th anniversary. And they have added updates to Wildlands including graphical settings updates and new DLC missions.
[stephenrberg] I would like to add that The Predator Mission and DLC is back! Along with a 4K60 patch for Series X / PS5
[Commander Shepard] This is a seriously underrated game.
Its a mix between the old Mercenaries games and Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter.
Co-op is great too. Its a perfect game where you can just chill with your mates and slowly work through the missions.
